modes.label: Auto
modes.behaviour: Follows prefers-color-scheme, resolved before paint by an inline script and kept in sync while open.

themes.storage: Cookies jr-palette and jr-mode (1 year, SameSite=Lax); the server renders data-palette, data-mode and .dark on <html>.
themes.tokenKeys: Frontmatter color keys are <palette>-<mode>-<css var>; every block defines the same roles.

display.purpose: Large figures in the Aujourd'hui record and stats facts; numbers, not prose.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing; every state change.

motion.name: dur

components.css: .ds-row { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px minmax(0,1fr) 9.5rem 2.5rem; align-items: center; column-gap: 16px; height: 58px; padding: 0 24px; background: var(--background, #f7f8fa); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft, #e9ecf1); color: var(--foreground, #161b23); font: 400 13px/1.45 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-feature-settings: 'tnum', 'cv11'; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--raised-hover, #f0f3f8); } .ds-row[aria-current=true] { background: var(--raised, #e8eef9); } .ds-row[aria-current=true]::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 1px; background: var(--primary, #2f5fd0); } .ds-score { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; width: 72px; } .ds-score b { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-ledger { display: flex; width: 72px; height: 5px; border-radius: 1px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--ledger-track, #e2e7ef); } .ds-ledger i { height: 100%; } .ds-main { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-main strong { font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-main small { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #5b6574); } .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--st-saved, #6d4fd6); } .ds-pill::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-meta { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #5b6574); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-meta:last-child { text-align: right; }

narrative.overview:
JobRadar reads like a university transcript or a registrar's ledger. Every offer is a record line, and its score is itemized rather than given as a bare figure: a fixed-scale ledger bar in the list that expands into the "Relevé du score" in the reading pane. The record is written in one of two inks, Encre bleue (the default) or Encre violette, on paper by day or on ink by night. Text is one record tone with a single metadata tone below it.

The density is that of a working instrument for one person at a desktop keyboard, phone second. Body copy is 13px, rows are 58px, and controls are 32px. From md up the app is the viewport: the rail stays put and each work area scrolls on its own, so the list, the reading pane and their footers never leave the screen. Depth comes from tone and hairlines, never shadows or elevation. Status colours are flat and committed, and they never share the ink's hue. Motion exists only to confirm a change of state, and every write is instant, optimistic and undoable.

The direction refuses the category default: a grey table with a coloured score pill beside a separate stats dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks (`data-palette`: bleu, violet), each with a light and a dark mode (`.dark`); mode is Auto, Clair or Sombre.
One accent per ink; the ledger ramp starts at it and fades toward the ground.
Two text tones, nothing in between.
The score ledger bar: one 100-point scale, same size and baseline everywhere.
Hairline borders for all separation, including floating layers.
The viewport is the app from md up; work areas scroll independently.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Rule
rules.body: Text is record text or metadata text. There is no third grey, and opacity tints of text are not allowed. Job description prose is the one documented exception, mixed at 88% foreground into the ground.

rules.name: The Committed Status Rule
rules.body: Each status has one colour, used for its pill, dot, column rule and due-list label. A status colour never decorates anything that is not that status.

rules.name: The Ink-Apart Rule
rules.body: No status colour shares the active ink's hue. When an ink changes, the status that would collide with it (saved) moves to the other side.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The ink accent is the only accent. Selection, the primary action, positive points and links share it, which is why it stays scarce.

rules.name: The Same-Roles Rule
rules.body: Every ink and mode defines every role. New colours are added as a role in all four blocks, never as a literal in a component.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every figure is set tabular (`tnum` on body, plus `tabular-nums` on counts, scores and dates). Columns of numbers have to align like a ledger.

rules.name: The Column-Head Rule
rules.body: Uppercase labels head a real section or column whose content follows directly below. They are never placed above a headline as decoration.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separation is always a 1px border or a 1px gap, never a shadow, glow or blur.

rules.name: The Selection Rule
rules.body: A selected row gets the raised ground plus a 1px accent rule on its left edge. Nothing else marks selection.

dos: Do show every score as ScoreMark or Ledger, on the fixed 72px, 100-point scale, wherever a score appears.
Do keep text to record text and metadata text, with tabular figures.
Do use colour only through role custom properties, defined in all four ink/mode blocks.
Do separate with 1px hairlines (`border`, `border-soft`) and depth through tone (ground, raised hover, surface, raised).
Do mark selection with the raised ground plus a 1px accent rule.
Do use one status colour per status, everywhere that status appears, on a hue apart from the ink.
Do give each work area its own scroll from md up, with its header and footer rows fixed.
Do make every write optimistic, undoable with `z`, and rolled back with an error toast on failure.
Do give every new action a key and list it in the `?` sheet.
Do limit motion to 120 or 180ms ease-out on state changes, and respect reduced motion.
Do head sections with 11px uppercase labels only when real content follows.
donts: Don't use box shadows, glows or blur, on floating layers or anywhere else.
Don't show a bare score number or a coloured score pill without its ledger.
Don't wrap list rows or pane sections in cards. The pipeline card is the only bordered tile.
Don't add a third text tone or use opacity-tinted text.
Don't use a status hue for decoration, or the accent for anything other than selection, the primary action, positive points, links and focus.
Don't hard-code a hex in a component; the identity swatches in Apparence are the one exception.
Don't add pagination to the triage list; it loads as you scroll.
Don't animate on load, loop, shimmer, or move layout outside a state change.
Don't add a second typeface or a system display face.
